_doc: The public pages of one subject, built from one lite-N by cad/viewer/pages.py (vt350#220). Top level: what to export, the render look (owner 2026-11-17: AgX Punchy, plastic 0.2, -1.4 EV; the key light turns and tilts with each camera), where pages go ('release' takes {model}). 'turntable': cameras and page text. 'viewer' (optional): the live 3D page, its GLB and its compare render.

turntable.blurb: 252 Blender Cycles renders of the whole VT350 with its e-box and EMU: drag round it at 36 angles and seven heights, from 40° below to 40° above.

page.title: VT350 ·
page.model_note: the printer with its e-box and EMU
page.foot: Real Blender Cycles renders (render.py, the render colour map, AgX Punchy, −1.4 EV), one every 10° round the printer at seven heights, from 40° below to 40° above, without the base board it stands on. The light turns with the camera. Drag sideways to turn it, up or down to change the height; arrow keys work too.
